Explicit command workdir/cwd and git target checkout determine ownership checks.
Native cleanup runs from another checkout and removes only merged completed jobs.

Completion matches whole card IDs in explicit commit headers, not sibling substrings.
Incidental prose mentions cannot close unrelated cards; actual Git/Beads regression passed.
Board touch reconciles recorded state and journals; close reason prose cannot advance named jobs.
An unrelated helper result cannot waive owned unfinished work at Stop.
Question punctuation no longer waives the completion check.
Compound and prefixed bd commands retain the session actor; native workflow commands receive BEADS_ACTOR.
Explicit actor impersonation is denied and state changes check claimed ownership.

Protected refs require a prepared landing journal and fast-forward proof in the real Git hook.
Generated closable workflow steps retired; checks/review are evidence on the deliverable and cleanup needs no commit.
Review findings remain on the deliverable; no generated parent gate blocks the work required to answer them.
Recursive epic projection cannot show manager review while any required descendant is still being built.
Ticket wording and evidence-length preferences are guidance, with nonempty acceptance required.
Native job creation has no prose-regex gates or mandatory artificial step cards.
Independent Claude review uses a private Read/Grep/Glob-only profile, strict empty MCP and no inherited bypass.
